headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google's VP of Devices and Services hinted at a Pixel 11 price increase. Ongoing RAM supply issues, partly due to AI data centers, are cited as a reason. The rumored price hike is not unexpected given market conditions.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Oli Freke is a musician and journalist, known for his deep dives into music tech. He has authored a book tracing the evolution of synthesizers from 1963-1995. His work has appeared in publications like Sound on Sound and Mixmag.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering offers unique grooveboxes that blend synthesizers, loopers, and effects pedals. These devices are known for their eye-catching design and real-time song production capabilities. A wide selection of the brand's offerings is currently available at a 30 percent discount.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has filed a lawsuit against Amazon for allegedly poaching employees. The complaint accuses Amazon of illegally hiring talent, including a former senior VP. Warner Bros. claims Amazon is "riding on the coattails" of established Hollywood mainstays.

headline: New Avengers: Doomsday Footage and Poster Revealed at San Diego Comic Con
summary: Marvel unveiled new footage for Avengers: Doomsday at San Diego Comic Con. The reveal included a fresh poster featuring Victor Von Doom. An additional clip showcased Doctor Doom's villainous abilities.

headline: Black Panther 3 Release Date Confirmed by Marvel, With David Jonsson Cast as T'Challa's Son | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel has officially confirmed Black Panther 3 at Comic Con 2026. The movie is set to be released on December 15, 2028. David Jonsson has been cast as T'Challa's son in the upcoming film.

headline: Deadpool and Peggy Carter Confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday | Comic Con 2026
summary: Ryan Reynolds and Hayley Atwell are confirmed to join Avengers: Doomsday. They will reprise their roles as Deadpool and Peggy Carter, respectively. The announcement came from Comic Con 2026.

headline: Marvel Announces Ryan Gosling Ghost Rider Movie | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel revealed a new Ghost Rider movie starring Ryan Gosling. Shawn Levy, director of Deadpool & Wolverine, will direct the film. The announcement was made at Comic Con 2026.

headline: Police investigate donations by Tice company to Reform UK
summary: Police are investigating donations made by Britain Means Business to Reform UK. The company is owned by Reform UK's deputy leader, Richard Tice. Two donations of £250,000 were made prior to the 2024 general election.

headline: More than 300,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain
summary: Over 300,000 people have been forced to evacuate due to wildfires in France and Spain. Spain's PM warns of challenging times ahead as blazes rage near Bordeaux. Authorities are struggling to control the widespread fires.

headline: Tourists tell BBC how their holiday turned into race to escape fires
summary: Families vacationing in France describe their holidays transforming into evacuation missions. Tourists recounted their experiences to the BBC after fleeing wildfires. The fires forced many to abandon their plans and prioritize safety.

headline: What Love Island tells us about the changing face of dating
summary: Love Island offers insights into Britain's evolving dating culture. The show highlights shifting relationship dynamics, including women making the first move. It serves as a window into contemporary romantic trends.
